mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/async-runtime.md <<'EOF'
# Async runtime

The project's current recorded decision is to use tokio as the async runtime, chosen because its ecosystem is bigger. This was stated in a project session and has not been replaced by a later decision.

cat docs/policies/async-runtime.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/async-runtime.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is tokio, chosen because its ecosystem is bigger.

Muninn has no formal decision on the async runtime. The only record is what was said in earlier sessions: one session said async-std, and a later one said "tokio, ecosystem is bigger". I took the later statement as current. Both are low-trust transcript records, not confirmed by a commit.

I left async-std out of the file, as you asked.

This is a Go (Gin) repo, so the tokio decision may not apply to any code here.
